7.description: [Pending Restart][Fire Fire Fireball] Increased damage of The Fire Fire Fireball proc by 30%.
[Pending Restart][Fire Fire Fireball] The Fire Fire Fireball itself is no longer able to proc other procs.
[Pending Restart][Fire Fire Fireball] The Fire Fire Fireball fixed a bug where brain freeze would not make Fire Fire Fireball instant.
[Pending Restart][Elemental Lord] Elemental Earth buff on your pet now reduces mana cost by 40%, up from 20%.

[Pending Restart][Elemental Lord] Elemental Frost buff on your pet that grants mana can now trigger from auto attacks as well, but now has a 1 second internal cooldown, but the mana restored to the pet has been increased to 5%, up from 3%.

[Pending Restart][Elemental Lord] Elemental Air buff on your pet that grants 30% critical strike chance with your next Elemental Blast can now trigger from auto attacks as well, but now has a 2 second internal cooldown.

[Pending Restart][Elemental Lord] Elemental Lord will now no longer be able to proc an elemental (Fire/Frost/Earth) again until all 3 have been procced. Example: You randomly proc Earth on the first hit, you can now only roll Frost or Fire on your next. If this procs Frost, you are now guaranteed to proc Fire. Once all 3 have been procced, it is again random on which of the 3 elements are proced.

[Pending Restart][Fingers of Death] New mechanic: Proccing Brainfreeze now also gives you the Mindblast! buff. Mindblast! makes your next Mind Blast instant cast, costs no mana and deals 25% increased damage and procs Fingers of Frost and Fingers of Death.

[Pending Restart][Spell Shredder] Your Elemental rends will now increase the damage you deal to the target with Fireball, Frost Bolt, Lightning Bolt. The mechanic works like this: Elemental Rend (Nature) will increase damage of Fireball and Frost Bolt by 30%. Elemental Rend (Fire) -> damage of Frost Bolt and Lightning bolt, etc.

[Archimonde] [Chaos Burn] Clarified the tooltip to state Chaos Burning only triggers versus monsters. In addition added Chaos Burning to the tooltip reference to improve the overall clarity of the Mystic Enchantment.

1.description: [Pending Restart][Playing with Fire] Cooldown reduction of the talent is now capped at 15 seconds per spell cast.

[Pending Restart]Rising Flames has a new Capstone Bonus: With the final rank of this talent, casting Magma Totem now gives the player a stack of Rising Flames every 2 seconds. Rising Flames increases damage of your magma totem by 10% per stack. Magma totem was a big outlier in terms of damage it provided by default. We are moving its power behind a capstone in a way that promotes careful planing of the placement of your totem.
[Pending Restart]Reduced base damage and scaling of Magma Totem by 50%

[Pending Restart][Fire and Brimstone] Now has a Capstone Bonus: With the final rank of this talent, dealing direct damage with a fire spell that has a cast time, inflicts the target with Soul Spark. Soul Spark increases the damage you deal to the target with your next Soul Fire by 10%. Stacks up to 10. Lasts 6 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Fire and Brimstone] Fire and Brimstone Talents and Mystic Enchants now also increase the damage done by your Soul Fire to targets afflicted by your Immolate.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - PvP related callboard caches will reward a Bloodforged Cache! This cache draws asymmetries to the Callboard Cache but has Bloodforged Gear inside! This allows a linear progression be formed from callboard quests for starter pvp gear!
[Pending Patch Update] - Fixed an issue where some instances in classic still required more than 2 champions.
[Archimonde] Gloomblade damage reduced by 10% in pvp combat.
[Build Draft] Disciple of Arugal: Added Seed of Corruption to 60 PvE build for an AOE option.

The Bloody Jar Changes announced in the League Overview Article are now live. It now costs Gold to convert items to Bloodforged With the addition of new gear acquisition methods for PvE, there was a lack of balance between Soulbound and Bloodforged. This change aims to increase the value of the High Risk Open World.

[Build Draft] Frozen Titan: Replace Precision with Benediction in early talents for mana sustain. Added Chance to hit Rare Enchants. Removed Sinister Strike Rare enchants since you learn Titanic Mutilate at level 20 (does not require Titan's Grip) and added Vitality enchants.
Temporarily disabled Build Master's Card while we resolve a crash involving them. These will be re-enabled asap.
Draft and Featured Builds will now work with multi-spec, meaning you can have an active build in specializaiton 1. Do a prestige in specialization 2 and select another build!
Build Master's Trophies are now only rewarded per unique completion across the account.

7.description: [Pending Restart][Harnessed Energy] No longer limits ability to Missile Barrage to specific spells.
[Pending Restart][Harnessed Energy] Arcane Blast debuff now stacks to 5. Up from 4.
[Pending Restart][Missile Barrage] Missile Barrage Mystic Enchant now increases the chance to proc missile barrage by 5%. Up from 3%.

[Pending Restart][Knight of the Eclipse] Lunar Knight increases damage of your next Starfire by 50% per stack. Down from 70%.

[Pending Restart][Frozen Chaos] Your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, Cone of Cold and Frost Shock critical hits grant you a charge Frozen Chaos and reset the cooldown of Chaos Bolt.
[Pending Restart][Frozen Chaos] During Splintered Chaos, your damaging hits with Chaos Bolt will increase number of targets hit by your next Chaos bolt cast. This effect is only active during Splintered Chaos and gives you the ability to hit up to 8 targets.
[Pending Restart][Frozen Chaos] Frozen Chaos buff now makes your Chaos Bolt do 25% (5% vs players) more damage and trigger no cooldown. It no longer gives additional bonus spell power scaling.
